_about: Menus run for menu_days days. buzz = extra customers a fresh menu brings. The player books the next one in advance.

menus.name: House Classics
menus.desc: The three everyone knows. Always available, never exciting.

menus.name: Street Slice
menus.desc: New York dough joins the line-up. Two doughs to keep proofing.

menus.name: Tutto Napoli
menus.desc: The old Naples menu. Mostly tins and jars, so little goes off.

menus.name: Garden Fortnight
menus.desc: Veg-led and cheap to stock in summer, but fresh veg does not keep.

menus.name: Roman Holiday
menus.desc: Thin rolled bases. You will need the rolling pin.

menus.name: Tiki Fortnight
menus.desc: Sweet and smoky on New York bases. Chicken and meatballs need a freezer.

menus.name: Fuoco
menus.desc: All heat, across three doughs. Prawns need a freezer.

menus.name: Butcher's Block
menus.desc: Three doughs and a lot of meat. Prosciutto goes on after the oven.

menus.name: Wholesome
menus.desc: Wholemeal and gluten-free bases. New flours, new dough recipes.

menus.name: Le Bianche
menus.desc: White pizzas with no tomato. A fridge-heavy menu.

menus.name: Riviera
menus.desc: Seafood and cured ham. Premium prices, short shelf lives.

menus.name: Trattoria Classics
menus.desc: Roman pasta sauces as pizzas, and mortadella with burrata.

menus.name: Autunno
menus.desc: Mushrooms and truffle. Glorious in autumn, ruinous out of season.

menus.name: Grand Tour
menus.desc: One of everything: four doughs, every store, every technique.
